notes.subject: בונה … יכנס
notes.rationale: Word-initial sound pair boneh/yekhannes frames the verse; the parallel build/gather movement is kept but the alliteration is lost.

notes.subject: נדחי
notes.rationale: Lit. 'the pushed-away ones' (דחה, push down); 'ol i puspisim i go we' keeps the pushing picture, 'ol man i go we long ples bilong ol' (exiles) is the softer reading.

translation: Yahwe i wokim bek ⟨את⟩ Yerusalayim, em i kolektem ol man bilong Yisrael ol i puspisim i go we.

tokens.gloss: ol man ol i puspisim i go we
